吉丽德·西居尔朵蒂.who: 北境的人族女子，冰原上那一圈石屋里长大。约3821年开春，长雪过后她踩着脚底结成的雪脊往返十一趟，把雪底下一百三十户背回墙下，被背出来的人先叫她背雪人。冰原石屋的人家和来往的牧人记得她。

at.text: 长雪那一冬她在墙下等了一整冬。约3821年开春她走进埋到屋顶的村子，一户一户挖开，背着走不动的人往南走了十一趟，名字从此凝住，约3850年走到传奇。往后每到雪厚的季节她就出去踩路，叫孩子跟在后头敲硬壳试雪。

吉丽德·西居尔朵蒂.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4297行起凡世至强背雪人（凝名纪年、凝名伟业、往后的事、使用规则），总表第167行，时段总纲第115行。who 里名字留在哪只写石屋人家和牧人记得，门槛底下的平石是她死后才埋的，没写进 who。

喀珥·燧环.who: 炎角燧环氏的魔族。约3602年寒星月，燧环氏的角火灭了，他拿燧石在自己的角上敲了七夜，第八夜敲出一点照得见十里的青白凉火，领一千七百多个同氏走出冲阵最前排。角冠家先笑着叫他烬寒，燧环氏往后照这么叫。

at.text: 约3600年燧环氏奉的亚米倒在死域深处，几千人角上的火一夜全灭，角冠家要把他们排在冲阵最前头。约3602年他在角上敲出凉火，领同氏退出那一排，约3603年带人到熔原东北的荒丘，往后仍随炎角出战。

喀珥·燧环.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4446行起凡世至强烬寒（凝名纪年、凝名伟业、往后的事），总表第207行。凝名纪年是约3602年，深营那一年是3600年，亚米倒下照凝名伟业写成深营之后。

格鲁什.who: 赭岭谱系的半兽人守将。3290年蝉鸣月塌口最后三天，他拔起木栅横架在地缝上，自己趴在最末一截当梁，八百多人从他背上踩过去，踩过他的人先叫他人梁。赭岭唱谱系歌的人记着他。

at.text: 3290年塌口名字凝住以后，他不肯让兵把自己当一座随叫随到的桥，在死域北沿修路搬石头三十年，约3320年走到传奇。3600年深营，他跟着白烛的艾丝佩北撤，走在撤路的最后。

格鲁什.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4248行起凡世至强人梁（位阶与职责、凝名纪年、凝名伟业、往后的事），总表第165行，补卷_68 塌口、深营。

瓦戈隆.who: 轰狱的牛魔，拆墙者拜恩座下。约3220年秋一夜，他在死域北沿两手推翻了十二座魔晶炮台，顶着德赫恩的九炮龙雷往前走，脚下烧出一溜坑，拜恩座下轰狱的营先叫他推炮。

at.text: 3046年拜恩的左肩叫神杀炮贯穿，他就在祂脚边。约3220年秋他推翻十二座炮台，回去以后左手两年合不拢，吃饭得让人把碗搁在掌心。往后他照旧跟着大军，在死域北沿拜恩座下的营里。

瓦戈隆.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4397行起凡世至强推炮（性格底色、凝名伟业、往后的事、使用规则），总表第206行。

艾丝佩·佐默.who: 木桥的人族白烛祭司，从小怕黑。3600年深营四十天，她在营心点着一支白烛，四十夜没让它灭，几十万人顺着那一点白北撤，走回墙下的人先叫她深营的白烛。木桥白烛圣所的门楣上记着她。

at.text: 深营回来，圣所在门楣刻下她的名字和四十道刻痕。她照样替伤兵换布，随担架队在南段和死域之间又走了五十年，约3650年走到传奇。4200年回马，她跟着担架队走在断后的骑队后头。

艾丝佩·佐默.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4154行起凡世至强深营的白烛（位阶与职责、凝名纪年、往后的事），总表第166行，补卷_68 回马。

荻薇丝·垂根.who: 碧穹银白古树根底下守根的暗精灵，持影。约3380年寒星月，她从南七段墙外一个有名者的篝火后头站起来取了他，几万魔潮天亮后散了，活下来的魔族先叫她火后之影。叫得出她名字的只有持影。

at.text: 约3380年她在南七段墙外名字凝住，约3402年第三回斩首那一夜走到传奇。3410年那一冬南段三百里墙外，站在魔潮前头的有名者天亮以前一个一个没了，一冬十九个。她不回王庭，回根底下坐在根缝边上跟根说话。

荻薇丝·垂根.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3607行起凡世至强火后之影（位阶与职责、凝名纪年、天灾那一冬、往后的事），总表第259行，补卷_98 持影。

伊莎波.who: 白鸢骑士家的人族女骑士，那时骑士还没有姓。4200年花信月上旬一日回马，她领最后三十几骑炉甲回冲九回，第九回把喀珥从熔角犀背上挑下来，撤下来的联军先叫她炉甲之锋。白鸢骑士城马厩里的人认得她。

at.text: 回马以前她在白鸢的炉甲骑队里。4200年花信月上旬一日神在死域深处倒下，联军北撤，她领最后三十几骑炉甲回冲九回，第九回挑落追在最前头的喀珥，回转时把倒下的艾丝佩抱上马背。
回马以后她仍领炉甲骑士出战，榛蜜在白鸢马厩度过余年，她骑过它的后代，也送走了许多匹马。4601年金穗月镜原，她领白鸢的炉甲骑士护着机甲的侧翼。

quotes: 榛蜜，借我一程。回来换那根磨耳朵的带子。
伊莎波.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4346行起凡世至强炉甲之锋（凝名伟业、往后的事），总表第169行，补卷_68 回马，补卷_69 镜原第12行。

泰奥多拉·施泰纳.who: 星环奥法研究所的人族束辉炉匠。约3936年一台试走的魔导炉心在环轨上炸开，她先喊一声停，两手把那团光按回炉膛，环轨外七千多人没有一个叫光照着，匠人先叫她按光。

at.text: 约3936年那一回她把整团光按回炉膛，那一截轨枕烧白了，研究所没有换，匠人在横梁的旧停字旁边补刻了一个更大的停字。约3950年她走到传奇，平日仍和匠人拆开旧炉看裂口。
她仍在星环的试炉场守着炉门，后辈想看她徒手接辉，她就先给人找一副手甲，让人先学怎么穿紧。4601年金穗月镜原，她跟着机甲守炉。

quotes: 今天吃饭以前。我这回记得住。
泰奥多拉·施泰纳.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4199行起凡世至强按光（凝名纪年、凝名伟业、往后的事），总表第168行，补卷_69 镜原第12行。

falls.how: 墙那一边一个戴贴面铁盔的有名者领魔潮从冰原北头压来，她守在石屋当中，绕村掀起六道雪脊，替撤走的人封住追路。他刀尖底下结的黑冰正克住她的雪壳，最后一户越过背风的坡，那一柄黑刀把她连同雪脊钉进了冰原。
falls.name: 黑冰
falls.light: flat white glare of a polar winter afternoon under low grey cloud, cold blue shadows in the snow, a few smouldering red horn-flames in the dark ranks
falls.camera: low behind her right shoulder on the crest of the innermost snow ridge, looking north up at the black blade and down the falling rings of snow, tilted slightly
falls.text: Scene: a grey winter afternoon on a flat white ice plain far north beyond the great wall, a small ring of low stone huts buried to the eaves in snow. Around the huts six tall ridges of packed white snow stand in concentric rings, higher than the roofs, and the outer rings are breaking and toppling outward like frozen waves onto the dark ranks of demon soldiers with burning horns that fill the plain to the horizon. Black ice spreads across the snow in long cracking fingers from the north. At the top of the picture, cut off by the frame, looms a huge dark armoured figure in a close-fitting faceless iron helm, his long blade raised high and already coming down, black ice crawling from its tip. In the near foreground, seen from behind at three-quarter, stands the snow-bearer, a tall broad-shouldered human woman of about thirty with pale rose hair in two long braids and ice-blue eyes, a thick wool coat reaching to her boots with a loop sewn on each side, her empty carrying harness gone, both boots driven heel-deep into the hard white crust of the highest ridge. Her face is turned up toward the blade in profile, jaw set, her nose red with cold, a cut across her cheek and frost and blood on her sleeve. Under her feet the white crust glows and is splitting where the black ice touches it. Far to the left, small, the last family of herders with a few frost-horned sheep is going over a low windward slope, not looking back. Loose snow and shards of white crust drift large and blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是黑刀压下来以前最后那一下，她站在最高那一道雪脊上，源稿纷争纪时段_四 凡世至强背雪人往后的事末两段（约4460年寒星月）。样子照仪容与印象（淡玫瑰色双辫、冰蓝眼、180cm、带抓手的羊毛外衣），背带照源稿交给了最后一队撤走的人，所以没画。有名者不点名，写成画框切掉的贴面铁盔和黑冰。脸上的伤是补的。

falls.when: 纷争纪4200年花信月上旬一日
falls.how: 回马那一天他骑熔角犀追在联军撤退的最前头，拿凉火把伊莎波的炉甲骑士一回一回顶回去，顶了八回。他的凉火压得住迎面的火，压不住她身后九道沟里一齐卷上来的火，第九回她的骑枪从犀角之间抬起来，穿透了他的胸甲。
falls.name: 凉火
falls.light: a pale blue-white cold flame on his horn lighting his face from above, hot red fire racing in from below and behind the viewer, black dead-land dusk
falls.camera: very low on the black ground just in front of the rhino's horns, looking up at the rider, strong upward tilt with speed lines
falls.text: Scene: dusk on a flat blackened plain deep in the dead land, where iron blooms into rust flowers and the grass is white, scored with cracks of frost-white and molten red. A great armoured molten-horned rhinoceros charges straight toward us, seen from the front: only its head and the front of its shoulders are in the picture, its head filling the lower middle. On the ridge of its nose grow two straight horns, a large front horn and a smaller one behind it, both pointing at the viewer. Its two front legs stand one on each side of its head, hooves throwing up black earth; no other legs are visible. On its back, above and behind its head, rides the cold-flame horn-bearer, seen from the front: his body begins above the line of the beast's shoulders, and his two legs sit astride its back, one on each side, boots in stirrups against its flanks; nothing of the beast grows from his legs. He is a slim demon man who looks about twenty-five, rust-brown skin, frost-white hair tied in a short tail, blue-gold eyes, two horns sweeping back from his brow ringed with pale tap marks, a small blue-white flame on the tip of his right horn. His right hand, on the picture's left, swings a long black-and-iron single-edged blade out sideways, and from its back a wide pale blue wall of cold light sweeps out over the field, flattening the flames ahead of it. His left hand holds the reins. His face is calm and lit cold blue. Rising from the bottom edge, between the rhino's two front legs and up past its horns, comes the burning tip of a long cavalry lance with a red tassel, and behind it nine long trenches of red fire run in from the lower edge and twist together into one spear of flame just about to strike his breastplate. Of the lancer only a red-hot gauntleted hand shows at the bottom edge. Far behind him, small, ranks of black demon cavalry stretch to the horizon. Sparks, ash and white frost blur over the corners.
falls.note: 画的是第九回骑枪从犀角之间抬起、九道沟的火合到枪锋、还没穿透他的那一下，补卷_68 回马、纷争纪时段_四 凡世至强烬寒往后的事。样子照仪容与印象。犀角写成直的，免得像月牙。伊莎波只露一只烧红的手甲，伤是照打过的仗补的（甲上的刀痕、灰），text 里没写血。

falls.how: 深营往回走的最后一夜，神战没散尽的余波把撤路后方的黑土一层层掀起来。他把背上的伤兵交出去，转身把重岭斧横进地里，托住十几丈高的断土，担架贴着土崖往前过。最后一队翻过北坡，红梁从当中折断，他没有走出来。
falls.name: 红梁
falls.light: night, deep red glow pouring from a beam of light along his back, one small white candle-glow far ahead on the slope
falls.camera: low and to his left side at ground level, looking up along the overhanging wall of earth, slight tilt
falls.text: Scene: the last night of a long retreat across the dead land, black ground under a starless sky, the line of retreat climbing a low northern slope. On the right half of the picture a wall of upturned black earth more than a hundred feet high leans over the road like a vast curved bow, full of broken bones and rusted iron, flowers of rust bursting open along it, its top cut off by the frame. Under the curve of that earth wall a dark red beam of light runs from a single figure far along the slope. In the near foreground on the left stands the human beam, a huge half-orc man about two metres tall who looks thirty-five, thick shoulders and long arms, short copper-red curly hair, garnet-red eyes, short tusks over his lower lip, a nick missing from his left eyebrow. He wears a battered chestplate dented by boot prints and an old leather strap across his shoulder sewn with small copper buttons. He is seen side-on facing right, legs braced wide, the long handle of a broad heavy axe set across his shoulder with its flat back pressed up under the falling earth, the axe head sunk into the ground. Blood and dirt streak his arms and neck, his face is turned up into the strain, teeth bared. A red glow streams out between the copper buttons on his strap. Passing under the earth wall in the middle distance, a line of soldiers carrying stretchers hurries uphill away from us. Far up the slope a small figure in white holds a white candle high. Dust, falling grit and red sparks blur across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是他托着断土、担架从土崖底下过的那一下，纷争纪时段_四 凡世至强人梁往后的事（3600年深营最后一夜）。样子照仪容与印象。远处举白烛的是艾丝佩，没写名字。神战的余波没有画神。

falls.how: 塌口最后那三天，神战的余波把两边的驻地一同掀开，轰狱的一营往裂谷里滑。他踏上崖沿，拿左肩顶住正往下折的整块地，灰黑的巨掌扣住三里长的断层，顶到营里最后一排爬到稳处。崖沿从他脚下碎开，他跟着落进了谷底。
falls.name: 崖沿
falls.light: harsh white glare from a far divine battle on the southern horizon, deep shadow inside the chasm, a faint red glow across the gorge
falls.camera: from inside the chasm below and behind him, looking steeply up at his shoulder and the hanging ground, strong tilt
falls.text: Scene: midsummer at the northern edge of the dead land, the ground split open into a vast chasm whose bottom is lost in darkness, the southern horizon flaring white from a far-off battle of gods. A whole slab of earth three miles long, crowded with collapsing tents, carts and banners, is breaking away and folding down into the gorge, its far end cut off by the frame. At the broken lip stands the cannon-pusher, a towering bull-horned demon over two and a half metres tall who looks about twenty-eight, deep bronze skin, short rust-red hair, molten gold eyes, two thick horns spreading sideways with the tip of the right one capped in iron, a chunk missing from the outer edge of his left ear. He wears heavy iron arm-guards studded with wedge plates. He is seen from below and behind at three-quarter, his left shoulder driven up under the slab, one foot on the crumbling edge, the other already on nothing. Behind his shoulders spread two enormous grey-black ghostly hands many times his size, gripping the length of the fault. His back is torn and bleeding, dust caked on his skin, his face turned up and sideways, calling to someone above. Above him a horned demon soldier throws a rope down to others, and a last row of horned men and women scramble over the lip to firm ground. Far across the chasm on the left a faint red beam of light holds up the other side. Falling rocks and dust blur across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是崖沿从他脚下碎开以前最后顶着的那一下，纷争纪时段_四 凡世至强推炮往后的事（3290年塌口）。样子照仪容与印象。上头抛绳的是梭达姆，没写名字，隔着裂谷的红光是格鲁什。没有挂 beast，那一仗的神不在画里。

falls.when: 纷争纪4200年花信月上旬一日
falls.how: 回马那一天她在断后骑队与伤兵之间点起一排白烛，连成几里长的白焰长廊护着担架北撤。追兵的长箭把长廊压矮，她一起身光就从脚下断开，她没有起身，把身子里剩下的暖连着火按进地里，长廊朝南扑成白浪掀翻黑骑。
falls.name: 白焰长廊
falls.light: brilliant white candle-fire everywhere, washing her and the black ground, a cold grey dusk sky beyond
falls.camera: close and low in front of her at ground level, looking past her kneeling figure toward the south and the rising white wave, slight tilt
falls.text: Scene: dusk on a black flat plain deep in the dead land, the retreat road running north. Behind the woman two long rows of white candles stretch away to the south for miles, their flames grown into tall walls of white fire that form an open-air colonnade over the black ground. That whole corridor of white fire is now leaning south and rearing up like a breaking white wave higher than the arrows falling into it, and at its far end the front of a dark host of black demon cavalry is being thrown back, cut off by the frame. In the near foreground kneels the white candle-keeper, a slender human woman of about thirty with pale lilac hair tied at her neck, lake-blue eyes and a small white porcelain candle-shaped earring in her right ear, in a long white robe to her ankles with a short cloak, its hem roughly cut short and muddy. She kneels facing us on one knee, her right palm pressed flat against the black earth, a stub of candle too short to hold beside her hand, and white light floods out from under her palm into the ground. Her face is pale and soot-streaked, gentle and calm, eyes half closed, sleeves singed at the cuffs. A small white-and-silver lantern cup lies tipped beside her. Behind her on the right, a line of stretchers carried by soldiers hurries away north into the gloom, and a single armoured rider in red-glowing plate is turning back toward her far off. Broken arrows, white sparks and ash drift blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是她掌心按进地里、长廊朝南扑成白浪的那一下，补卷_68 回马、纷争纪时段_四 凡世至强深营的白烛往后的事。样子照仪容与印象（浅丁香长发、湖蓝眼、白瓷烛形耳饰、剪短的白袍）。烧焦的袖口是补的。远处折返的骑手是伊莎波，没写名字。

falls.where: 死域北沿，担架队的伤兵棚边上
falls.how: 一尊魔神的火从死域里铺出来，宽十几里，祂的眷属里站在最前的一位要把火领到担架队的伤兵棚上。她不出刀走得掉，出了刀就走不掉，她从神的火后头出来取了那一位眷属，火偏了一偏，神转过脸来，她站的那一道影子跟着烧没了。
falls.name: 神火之后
falls.light: an overwhelming wall of orange-gold divine fire filling the background, the champion lit from the front, her figure a dark cut-out of deep shadow
falls.camera: low behind the champion's back, looking past his shoulder into the shadow he casts, the fire wall towering beyond, slight tilt
falls.text: Scene: night at the northern edge of the dead land, white grass, iron blooming with rust. Across the whole background a wall of fire more than ten miles wide and higher than any watchtower rolls out of the south, its top cut off by the frame, and inside that fire the edge of something vast and dark has begun to turn, only a looming shoulder of shadow visible. In the middle ground stands a demon champion in heavy burning horned armour, seen from behind, one arm raised to lead the fire forward toward the left. On the far left edge, small and low, stand the canvas tents of a field hospital with stretchers in front of them. In the deep black shadow the champion throws on the ground behind him, the shadow-keeper is rising to her feet: a slender dark elf woman who looks just past twenty, pale grey-white hair cut below the ears, a thin root wound around the tip of her left ear, deep moss-green eyes that do not reflect the fire, dressed in mud-coloured soft leather with moss stitched to her soles. She is seen in profile facing right, rising from a crouch, a short black knife of old root reversed in her hand, the blade already at the back of the champion's neck. Her face is quiet and level, a burn already blistering along her cheek and the edge of her shadow on the ground beginning to glow and catch fire. Embers, ash and sparks blur across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是她从眷属身后那一道影子里站起来出刀的那一下，纷争纪时段_四 凡世至强火后之影往后的事（约3470年）。那一尊魔神不点名，只画成火里转过来的一片暗影，没挂 beast。样子照仪容与印象（灰白短发、左耳尖缠根、深苔绿眼、泥色软皮）。脸上的灼伤是补的。

falls.when: 纷争纪4601年金穗月中旬五日
falls.where: 镜原，机甲侧翼的沸泥里
falls.how: 镜原最后那一夜，神战把湿地烧开，她领炉甲骑士守机甲的侧翼，马陷进滚烫的泥里。三道弧的火是从她炉甲里抽出去的，她一下马弧就灭，最后一队还在弧里，她站上马背连刺三枪，俯身护着马的耳朵，叫炉心的白光和合拢的水墙压进了泥里。
falls.name: 三道弧
falls.light: night lit by boiling white steam and red fire running in three arcs across the water, a harsh white glare from a cracked engine core above
falls.camera: low at water level in front and to the left of her, looking up at her standing on the sinking horse, strong tilt with speed lines
falls.text: Scene: night over a vast wetland of mirror-flat pools, the water boiling and throwing up white steam, a range of low mountains on the far horizon. Towering on the right side of the frame, cut off at the top, stands a great steam-and-crystal walking war machine of riveted iron plate, a ring of golden light around its back and a white crack of glare splitting its side. Below it in the near foreground a horse is sunk in boiling mud to its neck, and standing upright on its back is the forge-armoured lancer, a human woman of about thirty with short apricot-gold hair, a lock sticking out from under her helmet strap, green eyes and a few faint freckles on her left cheek. She wears red-glowing forge plate armour with a white kite-feather clasp on her cloak, her boots on the saddle, thrusting a long red-tasselled lance forward to the left. From the lance a trail of fire runs low across the water and splits into three burning arcs that curve away to the north, and inside the arcs a column of armoured riders splashes out toward the dark edge of the wetland. On her right two walls of boiling water stand up and begin to fold inward. Her face is soot-blackened and fierce, a cut across her brow, blood at her lip, her other hand reaching down to cover her horse's ear. Steam, spray and red sparks blur across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是她站在马背上刺出第三枪、伸手去护马耳朵的那一下，补卷_69 镜原、纷争纪时段_四 凡世至强炉甲之锋往后的事。样子照仪容与印象（杏金短发、青绿眼、左颊雀斑、白鸢羽形扣）。机甲是魔导蒸汽机甲，约4200年以后才有，4601年对得上。伤是照打过的仗补的。

falls.when: 纷争纪4601年金穗月中旬五日
falls.how: 一台机甲的炉心在侧翼裂开，她攀上机背两手把炉辉往回按，伊莎波的骑兵从金环底下撤。炉膛缺了半边，她撒手就走得掉，可炉膛会在撤队头顶炸开，她压到第三回，金环脱开机身托走了撤队头顶的碎甲，炉光随即穿过了她。
falls.name: 金环
falls.light: blinding white glare bursting from the cracked engine core, golden rings of light around it, dark boiling wetland night below
falls.camera: from high above and behind her on the machine's back, looking down past her hands to the cavalry fleeing under the rings, tilted
falls.text: Scene: night over a boiling wetland of steaming pools under a dark sky, a low mountain range on the horizon. The picture is dominated by the riveted iron back of a great steam-and-crystal walking war machine, half sunk and leaning, its far end cut off by the frame. Its engine core has split open in the middle of its back and a blinding white light pours out of the crack. Kneeling astride the crack, seen from behind at three-quarter, is the light-presser, a strong human woman who looks about forty-five, short glossy blue-black hair, copper-gold eyes with fine lines at their corners, a faint pale burn across the bridge of her nose. She wears a polished leather apron over work clothes with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and layered mountain-bronze gauntlets open at the palm. Both her hands are pressed down hard against the white light, and from her palms ring after ring of golden light spreads out around the machine, stacked one inside another, the outermost ring lifting free of the iron and tilting north into the dark sky. Under the rings, far below, a column of riders in red-glowing armour gallops out across the shallow water toward the north. Through her gauntlets the white light shows the bones of her fingers. Her face, turned slightly toward us in profile, is set and calm, a burn reddening her forearms and sweat and soot on her cheek. Steam, white sparks and flakes of hot metal blur across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是第三回收掌、金环脱开机身往北飞的那一下，补卷_69 镜原、纷争纪时段_四 凡世至强按光往后的事。样子照仪容与印象（蓝黑短发、铜金眼、鼻梁淡白灼痕、皮围裙、坠日手甲）。臂上的灼伤是补的。

notes: 吉丽德的 who 没写石屋门槛下的刻名平石，那是她死后才埋的，只写了石屋人家和牧人记得她。
喀珥那一幅画的是枪锋还没碰到他的那一下，伊莎波只露一只烧红的手甲，要不要让她多入画请定。
荻薇丝那一尊魔神源稿不点名，画里只写成火里转过来的一片暗影，没挂参考图。
瓦戈隆、格鲁什两幅没挂 beast，塌口和深营那两仗的神都不入画，只写成远处的白光和余波。
伤口多数是照打过的仗补的（脸上的伤、灼伤、血），源稿没写具体在哪一处，raw 都写的 true。
